info.description:
Nextcloud SuperGrok OAuth. Conversation, Voice, Imagine. Sign in with SuperGrok / X Premium+. No API key. SpaceXAI.
Device code is the default sign-in. Browser paste-callback (`http://127.0.0.1:56121/callback`) is the backup.
This app registers Task Processing providers for Nextcloud Assistant, Talk AI, and other consumers:
* Conversation: TextToText and TextToTextChat * Imagine: TextToImage * Voice: AudioToText (STT) and TextToSpeech (TTS) * Assistant buttons: summary, headline, topics, reformulation, change tone, proofread, context write, emoji, translate
Clone or download this repository into `nextcloud/apps/supergrok` (the folder name must be `supergrok`), then run `occ app:enable supergrok`. Sign in under Personal settings.
info.author: SpaceXAI
